name: vCluster
summary: Isolated Kubernetes environments that give teams autonomy without multiplying the underlying infrastructure.
overview: vCluster provides isolated virtual Kubernetes clusters on shared or dedicated infrastructure. Frontier helps organisations fit that capability into their wider platform, including tenant design, security, GitOps, observability and day-to-day operations, so teams can self-serve without losing control of the estate.
